distinctions.paragraph: Generated manuscript paragraph. Unknown before generation.
distinctions.unit: Conservative semantic unit inside a paragraph. A paragraph may contain several units.
distinctions.provider_request: One HTTP/SDK invocation. Not equal to one unit.

strategy_a.name: A_ONE_REQUEST_PER_PARAGRAPH
strategy_a.description: One Semantic Gate request per generated paragraph. Units stay inside that request.
strategy_a.truncation_risk: Lower than chapter-scale; still unknown for very long paragraphs.
strategy_a.evidence_mixing_risk: Low: evidence_handles stay on one paragraph.

strategy_b.name: B_PARAGRAPH_GROUPING
strategy_b.description: Group several paragraphs in one request (pr array length > 1).
strategy_b.evidence_mixing_risk: High if grouped paragraphs share a response without per-paragraph allowed_evidence isolation.
strategy_b.resume_complexity: High: a failed group would need partial replay rules that do not exist.
strategy_b.response_size_risk: Higher; historical Terra outputs have been incomplete.

strategy_c.name: C_ONE_REQUEST_PER_CHAPTER
strategy_c.description: One Semantic Gate request per chapter.
strategy_c.historical_terra_incomplete_output_risk: High. 4B.2.11 and earlier Terra canaries showed contract/output issues; do not assume a chapter-scale JSON object will complete.
strategy_c.token_volume: Largest per call. Long-context Terra pricing is unmodeled.
strategy_c.validation_granularity: Too coarse: a single truncated response blocks the whole chapter.

candidate.reason: validate_response_202 currently errors with pr:expected_single_paragraph. 4B.2.13 build_semantic_request and 4B.2.9 build_model_request both emit pr=[one paragraph]. Strategy A is the only granularity compatible with the frozen 2.0.2 validator without changing historical contracts. This is not a real Terra validation.
